_help: Status effects. kind: dot (damage over time: pow = fraction of the triggering hit dealt per second, per stack), slow (pow = speed lost, 0-1), root (cannot move), stun, amp (pow = extra damage taken), weaken (pow = less damage dealt), shred (pow = armor removed per stack). dur = seconds (scaled by the source's statusP and the victim's tenacity). stacks = max stacks; at freezeAt stacks a chill becomes a freeze. type = damage type of a dot. Read by scripts/Status.cs.

poison.d: Takes poison damage every second; stacks up to 10 times.

rot.d: Scarletta's poison: damage every second for 15 s. Does not stack (a new blow only renews it); cleansing removes it, immunity keeps it off.

bleed.d: Takes damage that ignores armor; stacks up to 5 times.
